handoffs.message: Implemented Agora standalone workbench shell in the REAL frontend repo (ajoe734/execute-plans PR #170, task/AG-DYNUI-PROD-002-agora-standalone-shell -> dev), not the pantheon-vendored execute-plans/ mirror. Critical finding: the vendored copy is a .gitignore'd sibling-repo checkout that has drifted to a different architecture (no App.tsx/PlatformShell/router); AG-FE-DYNUI-*/AG-DYNUI-PROD-004 edited that mirror by mistake and never reached the real hosted app -- flagged for AG-DYNUI-PROD-006. Fix moves /agora out of PlatformShellRoute (stays in AuthProvider/TooltipProvider/ErrorBoundary), preserves live-status via extracted useLiveSseConnection() + LiveStatusBanner without Management-only overlay chrome, wires the previously-dead :workshopId param into TradingDeskLayout/ServantDrawer with real getWorkshop() context instead of a placeholder, and makes the drawer/tab bar mobile-safe. Verified: npm test 118 files/1102 tests, npm run build, tsc --noEmit, eslint clean. execute-plans PR #170 CI (Pantheon FE-BFF Integration Gate) was still running at handoff. Full details in docs/bff/execution-tasks/2026-07-03-agora-dynui-production-gap/AG-DYNUI-PROD-002-standalone-workbench-shell.md (Implementation Notes section). Pantheon-side doc PR: https://github.com/ajoe734/pantheon/pull/2864 (auto-merge enabled).
